products.shortDescription: Generate colliders for complex meshes directly inside Unity.
products.description: 3D Collider generates surface-based Mesh Colliders for static geometry and compound collider solutions for Rigidbody workflows, helping preserve holes, tunnels, passages and other important spaces in complex models.
features: Surface-based non-convex Mesh Colliders for static geometry
Closed convex collider workflow for Rigidbody objects
Support for complex, concave and open source meshes
Adjustable generation settings and Scene view visualization
